title: Others’ attention is modeled as a force-carrying beam from the eyes

statements.text: People automatically and implicitly model the vision of others as beams that leave the eyes and gently push on objects, a simplifying construct present even in people who reject extramission. The model may help track who attends to what, by exaptation of motion processing.

sources.quote: people automatically and implicitly generate a model of other people’s vision that uses the simplifying construct of beams coming out of the eyes
We suggest that these illusory motion signals are an example of evolutionary exaptation
